measurement.metric: Arithmetic mean of 30 individual GEMM kernel GPU durations per shape, excluding quantization and inter-kernel gaps

compute_utilization.peak_derivation: 72 PFLOP/s sparse per system / 2 / 8 GPUs = 4.5 PFLOP/s dense per GPU
compute_utilization.meaning: Useful dense GEMM throughput / advertised dense FP8 peak; not an SM-active or Tensor Core hardware counter

assumptions: Each FP8 input element is read from HBM once per GEMM invocation
Each BF16 output element is written once; no previous output is read
No input data persists in cache across invocations; perfect reuse after the first read within an invocation
exclusions: Additional input fetches or writeback overhead
assumed_hbm_utilization.meaning: Assumed logical tensor-payload bandwidth / nominal HBM peak, not measured physical HBM traffic
